spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:8:7: command demo: flag "force": sets `complete` but its type is bool, which takes no value — there is nothing to complete
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:16:7: command demo: flag "out": sets `complete.extensions` with kind "directory" — extensions narrow files, so they apply to kind "file" only
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:27:7: command demo: env "region": sets `complete`, which describes a value typed on the command line — only flags and arguments are, so here it would be silently ignored
